command: echo ===MACHINECTL_STATUS===; machinectl status entityos --no-pager || true; echo ===MACHINECTL_SHOW===; machinectl show entityos -p Name -p State -p Service -p Leader -p RootDirectory -p Timestamp -p Id -p Class --no-pager || true; echo ===NSPAWN_PROCS===; ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,etimes,user,cmd | grep '[s]ystemd-nspawn' || true; echo ===ENTITYOS_UNITS===; systemctl list-units --all --no-pager | grep -Ei 'entityos|machine-' || true
